localChanges: When a city asks what to build, it now says why: what it has just finished, what it can no longer build, or that the city has just been founded or captured (closes #716).
A city building something an advance has made obsolete, such as Spearman once you know Gunpowder, now stops and asks what to build instead, rather than carrying on with it (closes #693).
A new option, Keep building military units, has a city that finishes any unit but Settlers, Diplomat or Caravan start another of the same, without asking or announcing it each time (closes #690).
Another, New cities build a defender, starts each city you found on the best of Mechanised Infantry, Rifleman, Musketman, Spearman and Warrior you can build (closes #691).

log: `created.ts` marks a new city's build `created`, and `captured.ts` cancels a captured city's as `captured`, or marks it so when nothing was being built, so the production picker can say why it opened (civ-clone/web-renderer#716).
feat: a new city's first build, and a captured city's, are asked for as such
chore: require core-city-build 0.1.18, for BuildPreferencesRegistry and cleared()

`city/building-complete/repeat-military-unit` (High, before the completion is announced): with the owner's `repeat` preference on, a city not on Auto that finished a unit other than Settlers, Diplomat or Caravan builds another, while it can (civ-clone/web-renderer#690).

`city/created/first-build-defender` (Low, after the build is registered): with `firstBuild` on, a new city starts on the first of Mechanized Infantry, Rifleman, Musketman, Spearman and Warrior it can build (civ-clone/web-renderer#691).

`player/research-complete/revalidate-builds`: each of the player's cities revalidates its build, so one an advance has made obsolete (Spearman at Gunpowder) is cleared as `unavailable` and asked for again (civ-clone/web-renderer#693). Civ1 builds it anyway; this is a deliberate change.
Registered after civ1-city's emit rule, as in a game, so only the High priority puts the repeat first; fails without it.
feat: repeat military units, a defender for new cities, and drop builds an advance obsoletes

`cleared()` gives the reason and the item: `completed` (from `check()`), `cancelled` (`cancel()`, which now takes a reason), `unavailable` (`revalidate()`), or one a ruleset sets with `setCleared()`, such as `created` or `captured`. Choosing a build forgets it. It's a key, so the renderer's production picker can say why it opened, and it's saved; a save made before it existed reads as `null` (civ-clone/web-renderer#716, #693).

Two flags per player, `repeat` and `firstBuild`, both off unless set. The ruleset decides what repeats and what a first build is. A client sets them from its own options each session, so they aren't saved (civ-clone/web-renderer#690, #691).
fix: BuildPreferencesRegistry holds its players weakly, so a finished game's aren't kept
feat: CityBuild remembers why it is building nothing; BuildPreferencesRegistry
